skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze speaker's message and convey it accurately in the target language within 20-30 seconds.
Accurately interpret and convey messages in real-time during presentations, meetings, and lectures.
Build and maintain a glossary of specialized terminology used in economics, management, and business fields.
Develop methods for evaluating the quality of translation work.
Proactively seek feedback on the quality of translation work.
Use technology tools to support translation tasks in various professional settings.
Recognize the need for lifelong learning to continuously improve translation skills in different professional contexts.
Create a translation notebook to document learned terminology and translation techniques.
Refine professional ethics in the field of translation.
Develop skills for working in teams and leading groups.
